note: The two sets are essentially identical in content: both capture the s-coordinate endpoints, the ontology definition standard, the composite layer definition, the flatback trailing-edge definition, and the damping values. Both make the same two errors — the edgewise damping is stated as 5% while the source says 3% (flapwise, edgewise, torsional = 3%, 3%, 6%), and both misbind the flatback midpoint definition to 'normalized arc length position' instead of the trailing edge. The only difference is phrasing of the composite-layer claim (A keeps 'following the curved blade reference axis' as a condition, B folds it into the value), which is immaterial.
